plan.summary: Initial unverified report indicates a PlayStation 5 Pro with no power and visible HDMI port damage; console remains uninspected internally and warranty seal status is contradictory between seller claims and physical inspection.

hypotheses.mechanism: Mechanical HDMI damage caused electrical short on 5V HDMI line or crushed pins bridging power/ground rail, triggering PSU protection or preventing standby rail generation.
hypotheses.why: Reports confirm physical HDMI port damage alongside immediate failure to power on.
hypotheses.safe_test: Perform an unpowered visual inspection with magnification and an unpowered resistance/continuity check with a multimeter across HDMI connector pins to chassis ground while AC mains is completely disconnected.

hypotheses.mechanism: Internal power supply unit (PSU) failure or tripped primary/secondary fuse preventing standby power delivery.
hypotheses.why: Device exhibits complete lack of power response with zero signs of life upon plug-in.
hypotheses.safe_test: With the console completely unplugged from AC mains, remove the PSU modular assembly safely and perform unpowered continuity checks on accessible low-voltage fuses/rails without opening the high-voltage PSU casing.

hypotheses.mechanism: Standby power management circuitry fault or physical motherboard component damage from a prior drop or partial disassembly.
hypotheses.why: Seller reported prior opening (though sticker was present), and physical trauma sufficient to break the HDMI port may have cracked solder joints or damaged standby regulators.
hypotheses.safe_test: With AC mains disconnected, perform an unpowered visual inspection of the motherboard for cracked passive components, torn traces, or liquid/debris ingress around the power management IC and standby rails.

plan.next_safe_check: Disconnect all power sources completely, discharge ESD, and perform a non-invasive visual inspection of the external HDMI port pins using a flashlight and magnification to check for bridged pins.
plan.uncertainty: Evidence is derived entirely from preliminary unverified speech transcripts and secondhand eBay descriptions before board-level diagnosis; internal rail conditions, tamper history, and PSU integrity remain unconfirmed.
